header: A handful of people, larger, with a line each
lead: Two to six people at the avatar's largest size, each with a role, a short biography and a link on the name. Past six the row stops reading as leadership and starts reading as a small team grid, which is what the maximum is for.

people.title: The portrait is a circle
people.role: the shared avatar at its largest size
people.text: Which is what tells this band apart from the framed rectangles of Team Grid when both sit on one page.

people.title: The name is the link
people.role: and the heading is the accessible name
people.text: Rather than a second, vaguer target underneath repeating the same destination in weaker words.

people.title: Centred moves the whole cell
people.role: portrait, name, role and biography together
people.text: The align field centres the intro as well, so nothing is left hanging off the start edge of a centred column.
